headline: France enters technical recession after quarterly revisions according to official data
label: NEWS
caption:
France has fallen into a technical recession following recent quarterly economic revisions 📉

According to Reuters, official data shows the French economy contracted in consecutive quarters, triggering the technical recession status.

The downturn highlights mounting economic pressures in Europe as major nations struggle with growth and inflation.

What does this mean for the wider European economy in the coming months? 👇
